verdict.rationale: GitLab documents several ways to automate it programmatically: a REST API pitched for automating workflows, built-in CI/CD pipelines, an official CLI, the GitLab Duo CLI, and agent flows driven by triggers. However, nothing in the evidence explicitly shows the agentic features running non-interactively inside a CI job, and the CLI is evidenced only by a probe link. Missing for 10: explicit docs on running Duo agents or the CLI headlessly in CI pipelines, CLI documentation detail beyond a probe link, independent or hands-on corroboration of headless automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
